title: Fundamental groups of reduced real elliptic divisor spaces
exact_scope: Nonempty fixed-distribution components of positive-degree unordered reduced totally real divisors in a fixed linear-equivalence class on a smooth projective geometrically connected real genus-one curve with real points.
result: Each component strongly deformation retracts onto a torus of dimension the number of occupied real components minus one; its fundamental group is free abelian of that rank and its universal cover is contractible.
original_cubic_status: The nine-point cubic fundamental-group dichotomy is already stated by Oleg Viro, with initial examples and observations credited to Ayşegül Öztürkalan.

review.acceptance_meaning: The mathematical assessment in AUDIT_REPORT.md; not a journal or referee acceptance.
